title: Source strict-local stalk comparison is invertible
statement: Let S,T,X,X' be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X→S quasi-compact (the inverse image of every affine open is quasi-compact) and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and (g':X'→X,f':X'→T,f,g:T→S) a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let k,k' be separably closed fields, Ω an algebraically closed field, σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k'→T, ι:Spec k'→Spec k, ν:Spec Ω→Spec k', with ι≫σ=τ≫g [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let A,B be strictly henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], eA:Spec A≅S_(νισ), eB:Spec B≅T_(ντ) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and put jA=eA≫j_(νισ), jB=eB≫j_(ντ), using the structural maps [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Let φ:A→B be local and ρA:Spec k→Spec κA, ρB:Spec k'→Spec κB satisfy Spec φ≫jA=jB≫g, ρA≫rA≫jA=σ, ρB≫rB≫jB=τ, and ρB≫Spec(κφ)=ι≫ρA, where rA,rB are the residue closed-point maps and κφ is the induced residue-field map. Choose X₀ with maps p₀:X₀→X and f₀:X₀→Spec A making a cartesian square over f,jA; choose X₁ with maps p₁:X₁→X₀ and f₁:X₁→Spec B making a cartesian square over f₀,g₀=Spec φ. For an abelian etale sheaf G on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and q∈ℕ put G₀=p₀^*G, K=G[0], K₀=G₀[0], with exact derived inverse image [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let C₁=H^q(g^*Rf_*K), C₂=H^q(Rf'_*g'^*K), L₁=H^q(g₀^*Rf₀_*K₀), L₂=H^q(Rf₁_*p₁^*K₀). Let e:C₁→C₂ and e₀:L₁→L₂ be homology of the two derived exchange maps [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange], and t₀:Spec κB→Spec B the closed point. Additionally choose b:X1->X' such that b g'=p1 p0 and (b,f1,f',jB) is cartesian. Use the explicit derived comparison maps u1,u2 of [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exchange-cube-comparisons], and put t=rB rhoB:Spec k'->Spec B. The point equation identifies t jB with tau. The induced homology stalk map r1:(H^q M1)_tau -> (H^q N1)_t is an isomorphism. This asserts only invertibility of the fixed source restriction map, with no assertion about exchange or its compatibility.

proof.text: Apply the closed-stalk strict-local base-change theorem to f, νισ, eA, sq0, G and q, using the residue-field point a=ρB followed by Spec(ResidueField.map φ). Naturality of the residue quotient proves t followed by Spec φ=a followed by the residue closed-point map of A. This is the explicit ht calculation in Lean.

Transport invertibility of this stalk map through derived inverse image by g0. The stalk-of-inverse-image natural isomorphism upperStarCompSheafFiberIso and the exact-inverse-image/homology natural isomorphism give two applications of NatIso.isIso_map_iff, proving the private helper isIso_stalk_homology_derivedUpperStar.

Unfold the fixed exchangeCubeSourceComparison. The only noninvertible candidate is the g0 inverse image of the sq0 mate handled in step 2. Its other factors are inverse-image composition isomorphisms, an equality morphism, and functorial images of the inverse-image/single-complex isomorphism. Map the composition through homology and the stalk functor and infer invertibility. The fixed derivedStalkComparison adds the inverse-image stalk and homology isomorphisms, so it is invertible too. No target component or exchange compatibility theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: 03Q9/03QO geometric step isolated in lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-base-change-closed-stalk; formal cube transport proved in Lean via natural isomorphisms and functoriality.

    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ))
    (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ τ))
    (φ : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)))
    (hφ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ eA.hom ≫
        strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) =
      eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ) ≫ g)
    (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
      eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ)
    (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
      eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ) = τ)
    (hρ : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map φ)) = ι ≫ ρA)
    {X₀ X₁ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ X) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (sq₀ : IsPullback p₀ f₀ f
      (eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ)))
    (p₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₀) (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Spec (.of B))
    (sq₁ : IsPullback p₁ f₁ f₀ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
    (b : X₁ ⟶ X')
    (sqB : IsPullback b f₁ f'
      (eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ)))
    (hb : b ≫ g' = p₁ ≫ p₀)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    let jA := eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ)
    let jB := eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ)
    let g₀ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
    let t := ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B))
    let ht : t ≫ jB = τ := by simpa only [t, jB, Category.assoc] using hρB
    let h : jB ≫ g = g₀ ≫ jA := by simpa only [jB, g₀, jA, Category.assoc] using hφ.symm
    let K := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G
    let K₀ := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (((p₀)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj G)
    let M₁ := (R+((f)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]) ⋙
      D+((g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K
    let M₂ := (D+((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]) ⋙
      R+((f')_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K
    let N₁ := (R+((f₀)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]) ⋙
      D+((g₀)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K₀
    let N₂ := (D+((p₁)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]) ⋙
      R+((f₁)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj K₀
    IsIso (derivedStalkComparison jB t τ ht M₁ N₁
      (exchangeCubeSourceComparison sq₀.toCommSq h G) (q : ℤ))
